before: always_ff @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n_enter) begin
proposal.description: The output stage loses its asynchronous clear: rst_n_exit is cleared by rst_n_enter only at a clock edge (a synchronous reset).
proposal.reason: rst_n_exit no longer falls the instant rst_n_enter falls; it stays high until the next rising clk, and never falls if rst_n_enter pulses low between two clock edges or the clock is stopped.

why: make lint already catches it: make lint: SYNCASYNCNET

before: always_ff @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n_enter) begin
proposal.description: The first synchronizer stage is cleared only synchronously, so meta_ff survives a reset pulse that does not span a rising clock edge.
proposal.reason: After a rst_n_enter low pulse shorter than a clock period, meta_ff is still 1, so rst_n_exit rises on the first clock after release instead of the second - the two-clock release is lost.

why: make lint already catches it: make lint: SYNCASYNCNET

before: always_ff @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n_enter) begin
after: always_ff @(posedge clk or posedge rst_n_enter) begin
proposal.description: The first stage's asynchronous event is the rising edge of rst_n_enter instead of the falling edge, so meta_ff is set at the moment of release rather than cleared at assertion.
proposal.reason: meta_ff goes high asynchronously as rst_n_enter rises, so rst_n_exit releases on the first clock after release instead of the second, for every reset however long.
